title: Nobunaga no Yabou: Sengoku Gunyuuden
native_title: 信長の野望・戦国群雄伝
overview:
The generals spring vividly to life. An immortal monument that realistically recreates the chaos of the Sengoku era!

Who will command generals of fierce individuality at will and fulfill the dream of unifying the land? Who will strike down the mighty foes blocking the way and drink the sweet wine of victory? Those who think themselves worthy, step forward! And fulfill the great ambition of Nobunaga, who fell with his goals unfinished!

A full-scale simulation game in which you become a Sengoku daimyo, lead many generals full of personality as your vassals, and use every strategy and tactic to unify all 38 provinces, including Kanto and Chubu.

- A multi-scenario system with two scenarios
- A multiplayer system allowing up to 4 players at once
- Choose any character you like from the daimyo who appear
- About 400 real historical generals appear
- Battles include field battle and siege modes
- Outstanding controls fully adapted for the Sega Saturn

武将達がいきいきと動き出す。
戦国乱世をリアルに再現した不朽の金字塔！

強烈な個性をそなえた武将達を縦横無尽に駆使し、天下統一の夢をはたすのは誰か？行く手を阻む強敵を討ち滅ぼして、勝利の美酒に酔うものは誰か？我こそと思わん者は名乗りいでよ！そして志なかばに散った信長の大いなる野望をはたせ！

戦国大名となって個性あふれる数々の武将を配下に従え、戦略・戦術の限りを尽くして、関東・中部をはじめとする全38か国を統一する本格派シミュレーションゲーム。

●2編のシナリオからなるマルチシナリオ方式
●最大4人までの同時プレイが可能なマルチプレイ方式
●登場する大名から好きな人物を選択可能
●約400名の実在武将が登場
●合戦に野戦、籠城戦モードを搭載
●セガサターンに完全対応した抜群の操作性
